title: Villagers stage dharna against house demolitions in Kosmi village

tea.why: Villagers protested against the demolition of their houses and destruction of crops during an official operation.
tea.want: Villagers demanded justice and intervention after their homes were demolished.
tea.changed: Oct 11: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan joined the villagers' dharna and contacted state officials regarding the demolitions.

summary: Villagers in Kosmi village of Budhni assembly constituency staged a dharna on Sunday to protest the demolition of their houses and crops in a joint operation by the forest department and district administration. According to news sources, families from the Barela tribal community participated in the sit-in after houses were razed and a well was allegedly filled with mud. Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan joined the protest, expressing strong displeasure and describing the action as unjust. Chouhan contacted the state's Chief Secretary and BJP state president, and stated he would raise the issue with Chief Minister Mohan Yadav. Meanwhile, forest authorities defended the operation, stating that it targeted illegal huts and encroachments built after a government plantation was destroyed.
demands: Provide justice and temporary living arrangements
response: Forest authorities defended the operation as the removal of illegal huts built after a government plantation was destroyed. According to reports, neither the collector nor the superintendent of police had reached the village to meet the protesters by the time the story was filed.

updates.text: Villagers in Kosmi village staged a dharna following the demolition of houses and destruction of crops.
Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan joined the protest site and called the Chief Secretary over the incident.

conflicts: Official accounts stated 10 families were affected, while reports from the village described 12 houses being demolished.
